business-technology__enterprise-applications__finance-ops__index.md:15:- **Navan Travel & Expense** (Travel Management)
communication__chat.md:25:| `#expense-reporting-inquiries`       | For questions pertaining to [expenses](/handbook/finance/spending-company-money/) (e.g. Navan).                                                                                                                                          |
finance__accounting___index.md:365:If you have an expense report that can be billed back to a customer please make sure to check the "billable" flag in Navan along with tagging the customer name under the "customer" field in Navan.
finance__accounting___index.md:445:### Team Member Reimbursements - Navan
finance__accounting___index.md:447:#### Processing Navan Reports
finance__accounting___index.md:449:1. Navan will auto sync and record expense reports into NetSuite once the report is "final approved".  "Final approved" means it has been approved by the team member's manager and completed an audit review by an Accounts Payable analyst or our external contractor, Montgomery Pacific (Montpac).
finance__accounting___index.md:454:- If you have an expense report that can be billed back to a customer please make sure to check the "billable" flag in Navan along with tagging the customer name under the "customer" field in Navan.
finance__accounting___index.md:456:#### Paying Navan Reports
finance__accounting___index.md:458:1. Team members in a US expense policy will be automatically reimbursed through Navan after their report is "final approved" within 1-4 business days.
finance__accounting___index.md:459:    - The team member must set up their bank account in Navan.
finance__accounting___index.md:460:    - Once an team member is reimbursed, Navan will auto sync the payment to the expense record to mark the report as reimbursed.
finance__accounting___index.md:469:    - AP will manually mark the expense reports as "Reimbursed" in Navan once they are confirmed to the payroll provider or batched to Tipalti.
finance__accounting___index.md:471:##### Paying Navan Reports in Tipalti
finance__accounting___index.md:485:    Number of days from when an team member's manager approves report to when AP analyst does final approval for payment or responds to team member in Navan if there is a concern. (Approval for payment is not the reimbursement date.) This is calculated on a calendar month basis. The target for this is currently three business days.
finance__accounting___index.md:487:1. Time to get a new team member set up in Navan < 3 business days
finance__accounting___index.md:489:    Have new team member set up in Navan within 3 business days from team member start date.
finance__accounting___index.md:506:In order to purchase goods and services on behalf of the company, you should first [consult the Signature Authorization Matrix](../authorization-matrix/) to determine the approval requirements. Note that this **does not** include travel expenses and other incidentals. These expenses should be self-funded then submitted for reimbursement within Navan, or in the case of independent contractors, included in invoices to the company (per the guidelines above).
finance__accounting___index.md:515:- The tag is created in Netsuite and syncs with Navan and Coupa.
finance__accounting___index.md:525:Navan will auto-sync any new "expense tags" on a daily basis, but if the Navan admin wants to manually sync they can do so by following these steps:
finance__accounting___index.md:527:**Import new Classes/Tags In Navan:**
finance__accounting___index.md:551:Tracking expenses for company Contributes enables us to analyze our spend and find opportunities to iterate, and in turn, improve subsequent Contributes. To enable tracking we create an expense tag that will allow GitLab team-members to tag Contribute related expenses in Navan. This should be done prior to the announcement of each Contribute.
finance__accounting___index.md:553:- To categorize an expense under an expense tag to track a specific marketing campaign, contribute expense and/or any special project you will do this under the "classifications" tag in Navan.
finance__expenses.md:55:- Expense claims for a single item up to $5,000 can be expensed via Navan. >$5,000 needs to go through the procurement process in Zip.
finance__expenses.md:57:- Navan Description box: Expense items must have a description filled out. This box is showing as optional but we require this to be filled in. This helps to correctly record the transaction and assist any reporting purposes downstream.
finance__expenses.md:60:[Omitted long matching line]
finance__expenses.md:68:[Omitted long matching line]
finance__expenses.md:69:- As with any third-party, it is best practice to limit the amount of personal data shared. The inclusion of personal data on your receipts is not required to submit an expense, so feel free to redact personal data for increased privacy. However, this is not a required step. For those that choose not to redact personal data from your expense receipts, the privacy and security controls in place at Navan were evaluated and they are designed to adequately protect your information.
finance__expenses.md:73:- Expenses flagged as "Out of Policy" in Navan may mean that the expense requires additional review due to requiring certain attachments (e.g., an approved issue) and approvals. Upon review, if more clarification is needed for a certain expense, the AP team will contact the team member via Navan to ask for justification of the transaction before approving or rejecting the expense.
finance__expenses.md:74:- Any exception to the policy is granted or denied at the discretion of the AP Admins. If the Admins determine that additional input is required, they will escalate the request to the team member's manager to make a final decision. Exception approvals can be granted within the Navan tool or via a Compass ticket.
finance__expenses.md:75:- There will be occasions where if you have claimed an item and it needs to be reimbursed back to GitLab, you will need to follow the repayment process in Navan for submission of the funds.
finance__expenses.md:80:- When booking travel in Navan, it's important to select the proper trip purpose type from the "Trip Purpose" dropdown menu. Selecting the correct trip type is essential for accurate data reporting.
finance__expenses.md:96:- GitLab's default payment method in Navan is a central company card.
finance__expenses.md:106:[Omitted long matching line]
finance__expenses.md:114:The airfare policy in Navan is set up as a "Dynamic Policy" which calculates a fair market price for every search based on travel dates and destinations. Any purchases that are over 20% of the Dynamic Policy will be flagged for further review by your manager. Also note that anything booked outside of Navan will flag as "Out of Policy", and will need to be reviewed by your manager and the AP team.
finance__expenses.md:143:- Please reach out to Navan Support if you need to change a flight.
finance__expenses.md:145:#### Common Out-of-policy Airfare Flags in Navan
finance__expenses.md:155:**Expense Type / Navan Policy Category:** Airfare
finance__expenses.md:160:- Rental Cars are reimbursable and should be booked through Navan, up to the intermediate car class, with a 7 day booking lead time.
finance__expenses.md:161:- Please note that anything booked outside of Navan will flag as "Out of Policy", and will need to be reviewed by your manager and the AP team.
finance__expenses.md:162:- Navan Confirmation should be attached to the claim along with the Car Rental Receipt.
finance__expenses.md:188:**Expense Type / Navan Policy Category:** Rental cars
finance__expenses.md:193:- When you book Hotels through Navan Travel, hotel room charges and the applicable taxes will be paid directly by GitLab through a central virtual card - the same way the company handles flights and train travel. The virtual card details will appear in Navan, our travel and expense platform, 24 hours before check-in and the hotel will automatically charge your room and taxes to this card.
finance__expenses.md:197:- Further information can be found on [Navan Help Centre](https://app.navan.com/app/helpcenter/articles/travel/myself/booking-hotels/virtual-cards-for-pay-at-hotel-bookings)
finance__expenses.md:198:- When hotel rooms are booked outside Navan - approval required by Manager and AP Admin.
finance__expenses.md:200:- However, the lodging policy in Navan is set up as a “Dynamic Policy” which calculates a fair market price for every search based on travel dates and destinations. This allows for some room in price in case the $300 USD limit is really not applicable to that area. And similar to airfare, any purchases that are over 20% of the Dynamic Policy will be flagged for further review by your manager.
finance__expenses.md:202:- The exception is the Corporate Events hotel room blocks organized by the internal team or if the conference hotel room block has better pricing than Navan.
finance__expenses.md:204:- Conference hotel room blocks or Corporate Events organized blocks will still need to be charged to a personal credit card and then submitted for reimbursement via Navan Expense.
finance__expenses.md:218:- Team Member to submit a manual expense in Navan using expense type "Lodging" and attach the receipt/invoice.
finance__expenses.md:225:**Expense Type / Navan Policy Category:** Lodging
finance__expenses.md:237:**Expense Type / Navan Policy Category:** Traveling: meals for myself
